question.question: Which of the following techniques are effective for reducing overfitting in deep neural networks?

options.text: Dropout applied to hidden layers during training
Increasing the number of epochs without early stopping
Using a larger batch size (e.g., 4096 instead of 32)

question.explanation: Dropout (A) randomly zeros activations during training, forcing the network to learn robust features. L2 regularization (C) penalizes large weights, encouraging simpler models. Data augmentation (E) effectively increases training data diversity. Increasing epochs without early stopping (B) typically increases overfitting. Larger batch sizes (D) often generalize worse than smaller batches due to reduced stochasticity and convergence to sharper minima.
